gear-weapon#0270.src: Many old mages had to perform lengthy incantations to make potent even their simplest spells. A mage cursed to be mute, however, brought upon a revolution to spellcasting through this simple wand.
gear-weapon#0270.dst: 옛 마법사들은 가장 간단한 주문조차 제대로 위력을 내려면 긴 주문을 외워야 했다. 그러나 말을 못 하는 저주에 걸린 한 마법사가 이 소박한 완드로 주문 시전에 혁명을 일으켰다.
gear-weapon#0270.flat: Many old mages had to perform lengthy incantations to make potent even their simplest spells. A mage cursed to be mute, however, brought upon a revolution to spellcasting through this simple wand.

gear-weapon#0271.src: There was glory in this place, once. Life, vitality, springing forth from every well and boulder. No longer. All that remains now is death, and a fleeting memory of that which once was.
gear-weapon#0271.dst: 한때 이곳에는 영광이 있었다. 모든 우물과 바위에서 생명과 활력이 솟아났다. 이제는 아니다. 지금 남은 것은 죽음, 그리고 한때 존재했던 것에 대한 덧없는 기억뿐이다.
gear-weapon#0271.flat: There was glory in this place, once. Life, vitality, springing forth from every well and boulder. No longer. All that remains now is death, and a fleeting memory of that which once was.

gear-weapon#0272.src: This enigmatic weapon can suddenly blink out of reality with no warning only to appear exactly where it was left later. Artificers have determined that almost the entire bow, by all known laws of nature and magic, should not exist.
gear-weapon#0272.dst: 이 수수께끼의 무기는 아무런 예고 없이 현실에서 사라졌다가, 나중에 놓아둔 바로 그 자리에 다시 나타난다. 기술자들은 알려진 모든 자연과 마법의 법칙에 따르면 이 활은 거의 전부가 존재해서는 안 된다고 결론지었다.
gear-weapon#0272.flat: This enigmatic weapon can suddenly blink out of reality with no warning only to appear exactly where it was left later. Artificers have determined that almost the entire bow, by all known laws of nature and magic, should not exist.

gear-weapon#0273.src: A boiling rage has been gathering, the pain of an entire empire yearning to be freed. With all the power of the downtrodden and the overlooked and the starved, you echo out a shout with ten thousand voices, each too quiet to hear by itself, but together a catastrophic force to make the heavens cower.
gear-weapon#0273.dst: 끓어오르는 분노가 모여 왔다. 해방을 갈망하는 제국 전체의 고통이다. 짓밟히고, 외면당하고, 굶주린 이들의 모든 힘을 담아 너는 만 개의 목소리로 외친다. 하나하나는 들리지 않을 만큼 작지만, 함께 모이면 하늘마저 움츠러들게 하는 파멸적인 힘이다.
gear-weapon#0273.flat: A boiling rage has been gathering, the pain of an entire empire yearning to be freed. With all the power of the downtrodden and the overlooked and the starved, you echo out a shout with ten thousand voices, each too quiet to hear by itself, but together a catastrophic force to make the heavens cower.

gear-weapon#0274.src: Time moves in strange ways around this translucent blade, speeding and slowing, starting and stopping, with no observable reasoning or pattern.
gear-weapon#0274.dst: 이 반투명한 칼날 주위의 시간은 기묘하게 흐른다. 빨라졌다 느려지고, 흘렀다 멈추며, 어떤 이유나 규칙도 보이지 않는다.
gear-weapon#0274.flat: Time moves in strange ways around this translucent blade, speeding and slowing, starting and stopping, with no observable reasoning or pattern.

gear-weapon#0275.src: The world suffocates under pressure, the seasons decay under age. The rivers dry up and the oceans flood the land while you helplessly watch your friends drop like flies.
gear-weapon#0275.dst: 세상은 압력에 질식하고, 계절은 세월에 썩어 간다. 강은 말라붙고 바다는 땅을 집어삼키며, 너는 친구들이 파리처럼 쓰러지는 것을 무력하게 지켜볼 뿐이다.
gear-weapon#0275.flat: The world suffocates under pressure, the seasons decay under age. The rivers dry up and the oceans flood the land while you helplessly watch your friends drop like flies.

gear-weapon#0276.src: After this crossbow's original wielder fell in battle, its mechanisms stiffened and locked into place. A spark of life, or undeath, can temporarily reverse the effect before the weapon seizes up again.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0276.dst: 이 석궁의 원래 주인이 전투에서 쓰러진 뒤, 그 기계 장치는 굳어 버린 채 잠겨 버렸다. 생명, 혹은 언데드의 불꽃이 무기가 다시 굳기 전까지 잠시 그 효과를 되돌릴 수 있다. 무언가를 향해 끌려가고 있다.
gear-weapon#0276.flat: After this crossbow's original wielder fell in battle, its mechanisms stiffened and locked into place. A spark of life, or undeath, can temporarily reverse the effect before the weapon seizes up again.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0277.src: Named for an ancient Wynnic word for "Earthquake", this mighty battle hammer causes the very bones of struck enemies to rattle and heave as though the earth itself was splitting under their feet.
gear-weapon#0277.dst: "지진"을 뜻하는 고대 Wynn어 단어에서 이름을 딴 이 강력한 전투 망치는, 맞은 적의 뼈마저 덜걱이고 들썩이게 하여 마치 발밑의 대지가 갈라지는 듯하게 만든다.
gear-weapon#0277.flat: Named for an ancient Wynnic word for "Earthquake", this mighty battle hammer causes the very bones of struck enemies to rattle and heave as though the earth itself was splitting under their feet.

gear-weapon#0278.src: The waves are not like men; they do not brazenly assault and catastrophically fail. They do not burn fast and wink out. They bide their time, they wait, and they encroach upon the world with an insidious, unstoppable force, dragging you away to the dark side of the sea.
gear-weapon#0278.dst: 파도는 인간과 다르다. 무모하게 돌격했다가 처참하게 실패하지 않는다. 빠르게 타올랐다가 금세 꺼지지도 않는다. 때를 기다리고, 인내하며, 교활하고 멈출 수 없는 힘으로 세상을 잠식해 너를 바다의 어두운 쪽으로 끌고 간다.
gear-weapon#0278.flat: The waves are not like men; they do not brazenly assault and catastrophically fail. They do not burn fast and wink out. They bide their time, they wait, and they encroach upon the world with an insidious, unstoppable force, dragging you away to the dark side of the sea.

gear-weapon#0279.src: Not knowing what's going on is the best part!
gear-weapon#0279.dst: 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 모르는 게 제일 재밌다고!
gear-weapon#0279.flat: Not knowing what's going on is the best part!

gear-weapon#0280.src: The first of her crimes was against the Church. She blasphemed and raved, cursing with the names of gods long-abandoned.
gear-weapon#0280.dst: 그녀의 첫 번째 죄는 교회를 거스른 것이었다. 그녀는 신성을 모독하고 날뛰며, 오래전에 버려진 신들의 이름으로 저주를 퍼부었다.
gear-weapon#0280.flat: The first of her crimes was against the Church. She blasphemed and raved, cursing with the names of gods long-abandoned.

gear-weapon#0281.src: Discipline and experience is channeled into these wands for {~} years in the Bantisu monastery of the canyon, in the hope that they will pass on its teachings to less experienced users.
gear-weapon#0281.dst: 협곡의 Bantisu 수도원에서 {~}년 동안 규율과 경험이 이 완드들에 깃들었다. 경험이 부족한 사용자에게 그 가르침을 전해 주기를 바라며.
gear-weapon#0281.flat: Discipline and experience is channeled into these wands for {~} years in the Bantisu monastery of the canyon, in the hope that they will pass on its teachings to less experienced users.
gear-weapon#0281._raw: Discipline and experience is channeled into these wands for 10 years in the Bantisu monastery of the canyon, in the hope that they will pass on its teachings to less experienced users.

gear-weapon#0282.src: "Can anyone else understand that General Graken? Because I can't." -Commander Takan, {p} Militia
gear-weapon#0282.dst: "그 Graken 장군 말 알아듣는 사람 있어? 난 못 알아듣겠는데." -Takan 사령관, {p} 민병대
gear-weapon#0282.flat: "Can anyone else understand that General Graken? Because I can't." -Commander Takan, {p} Militia
gear-weapon#0282._raw: "Can anyone else understand that General Graken? Because I can't." -Commander Takan, Nemract Militia

gear-weapon#0283.src: The whispers crescendo to cackles, creeping cries clouding your mind. You can't think. They eat away at the edges of your consciousness. You can't think. It's too loud in your brain. You can't think.
gear-weapon#0283.dst: 속삭임이 점점 커져 낄낄거림이 되고, 기어드는 울음이 네 정신을 흐린다. 생각할 수가 없다. 그것들이 네 의식의 가장자리를 갉아먹는다. 생각할 수가 없다. 머릿속이 너무 시끄럽다. 생각할 수가 없다.
gear-weapon#0283.flat: The whispers crescendo to cackles, creeping cries clouding your mind. You can't think. They eat away at the edges of your consciousness. You can't think. It's too loud in your brain. You can't think.

gear-weapon#0284.src: This dagger has no blade. Instead, it is layered with the stingers of the Black Shadow Scorpion, which has the ability to vanish entirely from its prey.
gear-weapon#0284.dst: 이 단검에는 칼날이 없다. 대신 먹잇감 앞에서 완전히 사라질 수 있는 검은 그림자 전갈의 독침이 겹겹이 붙어 있다.
gear-weapon#0284.flat: This dagger has no blade. Instead, it is layered with the stingers of the Black Shadow Scorpion, which has the ability to vanish entirely from its prey.

gear-weapon#0285.src: The melody hardens, groaning and clanking, a clash of iron on steel and a shout from a thousand trampled mouths in unison. It burns and breaks, a roar of unbridled power.
gear-weapon#0285.dst: 선율이 단단해진다. 신음하고 덜컹거리며, 쇠와 강철이 부딪치고 짓밟힌 천 개의 입이 한목소리로 외친다. 그것은 불타고 부서지는, 고삐 풀린 힘의 포효다.
gear-weapon#0285.flat: The melody hardens, groaning and clanking, a clash of iron on steel and a shout from a thousand trampled mouths in unison. It burns and breaks, a roar of unbridled power.

gear-weapon#0286.src: Ooze secretes out of every inch of this quarterstaff. Is it simply just more of the slime harassing travelers in the jungle, or is there something sinister at play?It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0286.dst: 이 쿼터스태프의 구석구석에서 점액이 배어 나온다. 그저 정글에서 여행자를 괴롭히는 그 점액일 뿐일까, 아니면 무언가 불길한 일이 벌어지고 있는 걸까? 무언가를 향해 끌려가고 있다.
gear-weapon#0286.flat: Ooze secretes out of every inch of this quarterstaff. Is it simply just more of the slime harassing travelers in the jungle, or is there something sinister at play?It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0287.src: A psychopath claiming herself to be Death incarnate used this dark-bladed scythe on a killing spree that lasted over a year. It reaped hundreds of lives, including her own.
gear-weapon#0287.dst: 스스로를 죽음의 화신이라 칭하던 한 미치광이가 이 검은 날의 낫으로 1년 넘게 살육을 벌였다. 낫은 수백 명의 목숨을 거두었다. 그녀 자신의 목숨까지도.
gear-weapon#0287.flat: A psychopath claiming herself to be Death incarnate used this dark-bladed scythe on a killing spree that lasted over a year. It reaped hundreds of lives, including her own.

gear-weapon#0288.src: The light refracted through this sceptre shows you visions. You see the endless waves reflected in its rainbows, cracking hulls and drowning towns. This prism allows you to channel a fraction of the sea's potential.
gear-weapon#0288.dst: 이 셉터를 통과해 굴절된 빛은 환영을 보여 준다. 그 무지갯빛 속에 비친 끝없는 파도, 갈라지는 선체와 가라앉는 마을이 보인다. 이 프리즘으로 바다가 지닌 잠재력의 일부를 끌어낼 수 있다.
gear-weapon#0288.flat: The light refracted through this sceptre shows you visions. You see the endless waves reflected in its rainbows, cracking hulls and drowning towns. This prism allows you to channel a fraction of the sea's potential.

gear-weapon#0289.src: "I bet those sewer-dwellers have horrible morning breath." -Folzoy, {p} Escort
gear-weapon#0289.dst: "그 하수도 사는 놈들, 분명 아침에 입 냄새가 지독할 거야." -Folzoy, {p} 호위병
gear-weapon#0289.flat: "I bet those sewer-dwellers have horrible morning breath." -Folzoy, {p} Escort
gear-weapon#0289._raw: "I bet those sewer-dwellers have horrible morning breath." -Folzoy, Maltic Escort

gear-weapon#0290.src: What chaos is born when the sun won't rise, as it lacks a sky upon which to dawn?
gear-weapon#0290.dst: 태양이 떠오를 하늘조차 없어 떠오르지 못할 때, 어떤 혼돈이 태어나는가?
gear-weapon#0290.flat: What chaos is born when the sun won't rise, as it lacks a sky upon which to dawn?

gear-weapon#0291.src: The radiance of your foes burns bright. You must emanate your brilliance in return. Cloak them in a blinding glow. Smother their luminance with yours. Then after all of their light has faded, yours will too.
gear-weapon#0291.dst: 적들의 광휘가 밝게 타오른다. 너도 너의 광채로 답해야 한다. 눈부신 빛으로 그들을 감싸라. 너의 빛으로 그들의 빛을 질식시켜라. 그리고 그들의 빛이 모두 사그라지면, 너의 빛도 사그라들 것이다.
gear-weapon#0291.flat: The radiance of your foes burns bright. You must emanate your brilliance in return. Cloak them in a blinding glow. Smother their luminance with yours. Then after all of their light has faded, yours will too.

gear-weapon#0292.src: There's a scrawling etched onto the handle: "UNGA BUNGA'S. NO TOUCH."
gear-weapon#0292.dst: 손잡이에 휘갈겨 새긴 글씨가 있다. "UNGA BUNGA 거. 만지지 마."
gear-weapon#0292.flat: There's a scrawling etched onto the handle: "UNGA BUNGA'S. NO TOUCH."

gear-weapon#0293.src: An effigy built from the stones of the mantle. It crushes anything in its wake.
gear-weapon#0293.dst: 맨틀의 돌로 쌓아 올린 우상. 지나가는 길의 모든 것을 짓뭉갠다.
gear-weapon#0293.flat: An effigy built from the stones of the mantle. It crushes anything in its wake.

gear-weapon#0294.src: "Cut a web, and its owner will feel it and come out. That's your chance to strike." -Lieutenant Van, {p} {~}nd Regiment
gear-weapon#0294.dst: "거미줄을 끊으면 주인이 알아채고 나와. 그때가 공격할 기회야." -Van 중위, {p} 제{~}연대
gear-weapon#0294.flat: "Cut a web, and its owner will feel it and come out. That's your chance to strike." -Lieutenant Van, {p} {~}nd Regiment
gear-weapon#0294._raw: "Cut a web, and its owner will feel it and come out. That's your chance to strike." -Lieutenant Van, Detlas 2nd Regiment

gear-weapon#0295.src: Wielding it for too long will leave one a desiccated husk, as this dull blade slowly absorbs all liquids around it.
gear-weapon#0295.dst: 이 무딘 칼날은 주변의 모든 액체를 서서히 빨아들이기 때문에, 너무 오래 쥐고 있으면 바싹 마른 껍데기만 남게 된다.
gear-weapon#0295.flat: Wielding it for too long will leave one a desiccated husk, as this dull blade slowly absorbs all liquids around it.

gear-weapon#0296.src: "As much as they're terrifying, at least those lousy skeletons give us lots of bonemeal for the crops!" -Bylvis, {p} Farmer
gear-weapon#0296.dst: "무섭긴 해도, 그 형편없는 해골들 덕분에 농작물에 줄 뼛가루는 넉넉하다니까!" -Bylvis, {p} 농부
gear-weapon#0296.flat: "As much as they're terrifying, at least those lousy skeletons give us lots of bonemeal for the crops!" -Bylvis, {p} Farmer
gear-weapon#0296._raw: "As much as they're terrifying, at least those lousy skeletons give us lots of bonemeal for the crops!" -Bylvis, Katoa Ranch Farmer

gear-weapon#0297.src: The average bow can boast a range of skills, but unlike this one, not every bow can penetrate through any organic skin, including dragon hide.
gear-weapon#0297.dst: 평범한 활도 여러 재주를 자랑할 수 있지만, 이 활처럼 용의 가죽을 포함한 어떤 생물의 피부든 꿰뚫을 수 있는 활은 흔치 않다.
gear-weapon#0297.flat: The average bow can boast a range of skills, but unlike this one, not every bow can penetrate through any organic skin, including dragon hide.

gear-weapon#0298.src: "Even a corrupted would get crushed by one of these!" -Roche 'Stone-thrower' Diamant, {p} Citizen
gear-weapon#0298.dst: "타락체라도 이걸로 한 방 맞으면 박살 날걸!" -'돌팔매꾼' Roche Diamant, {p} 시민
gear-weapon#0298.flat: "Even a corrupted would get crushed by one of these!" -Roche 'Stone-thrower' Diamant, {p} Citizen
gear-weapon#0298._raw: "Even a corrupted would get crushed by one of these!" -Roche 'Stone-thrower' Diamant, Ragni Citizen

gear-weapon#0299.src: Launch into the heavens, then descend with the fury of a raging storm. Drag the sky down with you, and shatter it upon the earth in a devastating torrent of wind.
gear-weapon#0299.dst: 하늘로 솟구쳤다가, 몰아치는 폭풍의 분노로 내리꽂혀라. 하늘을 함께 끌어내려, 파괴적인 돌풍의 급류로 대지 위에 산산이 부숴라.
gear-weapon#0299.flat: Launch into the heavens, then descend with the fury of a raging storm. Drag the sky down with you, and shatter it upon the earth in a devastating torrent of wind.

gear-weapon#0300.src: Abandon your fear. Look forward. Move forward and never stop. Retreat and you will age. Hesitate and you will die.
gear-weapon#0300.dst: 두려움을 버려라. 앞을 보라. 앞으로 나아가고 결코 멈추지 마라. 물러서면 늙을 것이다. 망설이면 죽을 것이다.
gear-weapon#0300.flat: Abandon your fear. Look forward. Move forward and never stop. Retreat and you will age. Hesitate and you will die.

gear-weapon#0301.src: The spelling seems to have been botched.
gear-weapon#0301.flat: The spelling seems to have been botched.

gear-weapon#0302.src: Many who venture into the jungle are swallowed by the thick undergrowth and are never seen again. This weapon and an accompanying skeleton were found inside the very adversary the spear was meant to vanquish as a perfect display of its owner's untimely demise.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0302.dst: 정글에 발을 들인 많은 이가 무성한 덤불에 삼켜져 다시는 모습을 드러내지 않는다. 이 무기와 함께 있던 해골은 이 창이 무찌르려던 바로 그 적의 몸속에서 발견되었다. 주인의 때 이른 죽음을 완벽하게 보여 주는 증거였다. 무언가를 향해 끌려가고 있다.
gear-weapon#0302.flat: Many who venture into the jungle are swallowed by the thick undergrowth and are never seen again. This weapon and an accompanying skeleton were found inside the very adversary the spear was meant to vanquish as a perfect display of its owner's untimely demise.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0303.src: "The sun and related symbols appear quite often in these ancient glyphs.  Interesting, but unsurprising, no?" -Svin, Legend Keeper
gear-weapon#0303.dst: "태양과 관련 상징이 이 고대 문양들에 꽤 자주 등장하는군.  흥미롭지만, 놀랍진 않지?" -Svin, 전설의 수호자
gear-weapon#0303.flat: "The sun and related symbols appear quite often in these ancient glyphs.  Interesting, but unsurprising, no?" -Svin, Legend Keeper

gear-weapon#0304.src: It is an apathy born from lonely desperation with which one sends a blinding ray as their signal flare, uncaring if it hails friend or foe.
gear-weapon#0304.dst: 그것은 외로운 절망에서 태어난 무관심이다. 아군을 부르든 적을 부르든 개의치 않고 눈부신 광선을 신호탄 삼아 쏘아 올리는.
gear-weapon#0304.flat: It is an apathy born from lonely desperation with which one sends a blinding ray as their signal flare, uncaring if it hails friend or foe.

gear-weapon#0305.src: This pike carries an insatiable momentum. The blade darts through the air, slicing through the wind with a speed so great the air screams in protest, a roaring echo to be heard miles away.
gear-weapon#0305.dst: 이 장창은 채워지지 않는 기세를 지녔다. 칼날이 허공을 가르며 너무나 빠르게 바람을 베어, 공기가 항의하듯 비명을 지르고 그 굉음의 메아리가 몇 킬로미터 밖에서도 들린다.
gear-weapon#0305.flat: This pike carries an insatiable momentum. The blade darts through the air, slicing through the wind with a speed so great the air screams in protest, a roaring echo to be heard miles away.

gear-weapon#0306.src: This bow's thick string fails to shoot arrows effectively, but instead produces low frequency sound waves that erupt from the source in all directions. The sound can implode the eardrums of an enemy with a single strum.
gear-weapon#0306.dst: 이 활의 굵은 시위로는 화살을 제대로 쏠 수 없지만, 대신 사방으로 터져 나가는 저주파 음파를 만들어 낸다. 한 번 튕기기만 해도 그 소리가 적의 고막을 터뜨릴 수 있다.
gear-weapon#0306.flat: This bow's thick string fails to shoot arrows effectively, but instead produces low frequency sound waves that erupt from the source in all directions. The sound can implode the eardrums of an enemy with a single strum.

gear-weapon#0307.src: Do you recognize the cries before you? Those so far beneath you, forgotten by time and betrayed by history. Hear their song- of asylum lost and vengeance unfulfilled. Bring them closure.
gear-weapon#0307.dst: 눈앞의 울음소리를 알아보겠는가? 네 발아래 저 멀리, 시간에 잊히고 역사에 배신당한 자들. 그들의 노래를 들어라. 잃어버린 안식처와 이루지 못한 복수의 노래를. 그들에게 끝을 안겨 주어라.
gear-weapon#0307.flat: Do you recognize the cries before you? Those so far beneath you, forgotten by time and betrayed by history. Hear their song- of asylum lost and vengeance unfulfilled. Bring them closure.

gear-weapon#0308.src: Recovered from the {p} Penitentiary, this grisly bow holds destructive capabilities. Used to carry out executions, a precise enough shot can shatter the soul of those it hits.
gear-weapon#0308.dst: {p} 교도소에서 회수된 이 섬뜩한 활은 파괴적인 능력을 지니고 있다. 처형에 쓰였던 활로, 충분히 정확한 한 발은 맞은 자의 영혼을 산산조각 낼 수 있다.
gear-weapon#0308.flat: Recovered from the {p} Penitentiary, this grisly bow holds destructive capabilities. Used to carry out executions, a precise enough shot can shatter the soul of those it hits.
gear-weapon#0308._raw: Recovered from the Lexdale Penitentiary, this grisly bow holds destructive capabilities. Used to carry out executions, a precise enough shot can shatter the soul of those it hits.

gear-weapon#0309.src: Arrows fired by this bow are pure ice, but when they hit the enemy, burst into magical water, flash-freezing all that it touches. The frost burns will never heal.
gear-weapon#0309.dst: 이 활이 쏘는 화살은 순수한 얼음이지만, 적에게 맞으면 마법의 물로 터져 닿는 모든 것을 순식간에 얼린다. 그 동상은 결코 낫지 않는다.
gear-weapon#0309.flat: Arrows fired by this bow are pure ice, but when they hit the enemy, burst into magical water, flash-freezing all that it touches. The frost burns will never heal.

gear-weapon#0310.src: "The plants loathe to take hold upon the red stone. And so, we must hunt instead."  -Caras, Owl Tribesman
gear-weapon#0310.dst: "식물들은 그 붉은 돌 위에 뿌리내리기를 싫어하지. 그러니 우리는 대신 사냥을 해야 해."  -Caras, 올빼미 부족원
gear-weapon#0310.flat: "The plants loathe to take hold upon the red stone. And so, we must hunt instead."  -Caras, Owl Tribesman

gear-weapon#0311.src: The art of endurance fighting is a skill lost to time. However, a thief that to this day has not been caught, imbued this dagger with the very same ability.
gear-weapon#0311.dst: 지구전의 기술은 세월 속에 잊혀졌다. 그러나 지금까지도 붙잡히지 않은 한 도둑이 바로 그 능력을 이 단검에 불어넣었다.
gear-weapon#0311.flat: The art of endurance fighting is a skill lost to time. However, a thief that to this day has not been caught, imbued this dagger with the very same ability.

gear-weapon#0312.src: "There's never new water flowing into those sewers. It all cycles back into itself...not natural." -Jenprest, {p} Legion {~}nd Division
gear-weapon#0312.dst: "그 하수도에는 새 물이 흘러드는 법이 없어. 전부 제자리에서 돌고 돌지... 자연스럽지 않아." -Jenprest, {p} 군단 제{~}사단
gear-weapon#0312.flat: "There's never new water flowing into those sewers. It all cycles back into itself...not natural." -Jenprest, {p} Legion {~}nd Division
gear-weapon#0312._raw: "There's never new water flowing into those sewers. It all cycles back into itself...not natural." -Jenprest, Ragni Legion 2nd Division

gear-weapon#0313.src: From afar, a faint light glimmers. A brighter light next. Another. Then another still. A cascade of blinding force, more than anything you could have ever imagined. And then... nothing. As though there was never anything there.
gear-weapon#0313.dst: 멀리서 희미한 빛이 반짝인다. 이어서 더 밝은 빛. 또 하나. 그리고 또 하나. 네가 상상할 수 있던 무엇보다도 거대한, 눈을 멀게 하는 힘의 폭포. 그리고... 아무것도 없다. 마치 처음부터 그곳에 아무것도 없었던 것처럼.
gear-weapon#0313.flat: From afar, a faint light glimmers. A brighter light next. Another. Then another still. A cascade of blinding force, more than anything you could have ever imagined. And then... nothing. As though there was never anything there.

gear-weapon#0314.src: Crafted exclusively by the Temple of the Legends' mages, this stave is honorary to Mages who best the Temple's Grand Magus.
gear-weapon#0314.dst: 전설의 신전 마법사들만이 만드는 이 지팡이는, 신전의 대마도사를 이긴 메이지에게 주어지는 영예의 증표다.
gear-weapon#0314.flat: Crafted exclusively by the Temple of the Legends' mages, this stave is honorary to Mages who best the Temple's Grand Magus.

gear-weapon#0315.src: "I swear on my life those spiders were covered in spikes! Go out there, see if I'm wrong!" -Suri, Elemental Researcher
gear-weapon#0315.dst: "목숨을 걸고 맹세하는데 그 거미들은 가시로 뒤덮여 있었어! 나가서 내 말이 틀렸는지 직접 봐!" -Suri, 원소 연구가
gear-weapon#0315.flat: "I swear on my life those spiders were covered in spikes! Go out there, see if I'm wrong!" -Suri, Elemental Researcher

gear-weapon#0316.src: If it weren't for that stray mark, this would be spelled correctly...
gear-weapon#0316.dst: 저 잘못 그은 획만 아니었어도 철자가 맞았을 텐데...
gear-weapon#0316.flat: If it weren't for that stray mark, this would be spelled correctly...

gear-weapon#0317.src: Do you ... really expect to be able to steal, or even touch, a single drop from that holiest-and cruelest-of springs?
gear-weapon#0317.dst: 너는... 정말로 가장 신성하고도 가장 잔혹한 그 샘에서 단 한 방울이라도 훔치거나, 아니 만질 수라도 있을 거라 생각하는가?
gear-weapon#0317.flat: Do you ... really expect to be able to steal, or even touch, a single drop from that holiest-and cruelest-of springs?

gear-weapon#0318.src: "Never wish to see a dead loved one again. In this day and age, they'll come back to see you." -Mylo, {p} Conscript
gear-weapon#0318.dst: "죽은 가족을 다시 보고 싶다는 소원은 절대 빌지 마. 요즘 같은 때엔 정말로 너를 보러 돌아올 테니까." -Mylo, {p} 징집병
gear-weapon#0318.flat: "Never wish to see a dead loved one again. In this day and age, they'll come back to see you." -Mylo, {p} Conscript
gear-weapon#0318._raw: "Never wish to see a dead loved one again. In this day and age, they'll come back to see you." -Mylo, Nemract Conscript

gear-weapon#0319.src: Deep, deep below the swirling, suffocating muck and the things that slither and crawl in the dark, there is a pulse. A wild, churning, erratic pulse, beating ever so quickly to the tempo of the earth, waiting to be unleashed.
gear-weapon#0319.dst: 소용돌이치는 숨 막히는 진창과 어둠 속을 미끄러지고 기어다니는 것들 아래, 깊고 깊은 곳에 고동이 있다. 거칠고, 요동치고, 불규칙한 고동이 대지의 박자에 맞춰 무척이나 빠르게 뛰며 풀려나기를 기다린다.
gear-weapon#0319.flat: Deep, deep below the swirling, suffocating muck and the things that slither and crawl in the dark, there is a pulse. A wild, churning, erratic pulse, beating ever so quickly to the tempo of the earth, waiting to be unleashed.

gear-weapon#0320.src: Its frame is as that of a horrid maw, its arrows hideous tongues of stone. They reach out, pulling their victims into an acidic embrace. What are they searching, grasping for? Perhaps some questions are wiser to ignore.
gear-weapon#0320.dst: 그 활대는 끔찍한 아가리 같고, 화살은 흉측한 돌의 혀 같다. 그것들은 뻗어 나가 희생자를 산성의 포옹으로 끌어들인다. 그것들은 무엇을 찾고, 무엇을 움켜쥐려는 걸까? 어떤 질문은 모른 척하는 편이 현명할지도 모른다.
gear-weapon#0320.flat: Its frame is as that of a horrid maw, its arrows hideous tongues of stone. They reach out, pulling their victims into an acidic embrace. What are they searching, grasping for? Perhaps some questions are wiser to ignore.

gear-weapon#0321.src: Once known as the Doomsday Weapon, it was ultimately never used for its intended purpose - its solar focus was cracked upon the day of its completion. All but a fraction of its energy was expelled, obliterating its creators, but overwhelming magical force still pulses and thrums through the web of fractures in its design.
gear-weapon#0321.dst: 한때 종말의 무기라 불렸지만, 결국 본래 목적에는 한 번도 쓰이지 못했다. 완성된 날 태양 초점이 금 가 버렸기 때문이다. 에너지는 극히 일부를 빼고 모두 방출되어 제작자들을 소멸시켰지만, 압도적인 마력은 지금도 그 구조 곳곳에 퍼진 균열 사이로 고동치며 울린다.
gear-weapon#0321.flat: Once known as the Doomsday Weapon, it was ultimately never used for its intended purpose - its solar focus was cracked upon the day of its completion. All but a fraction of its energy was expelled, obliterating its creators, but overwhelming magical force still pulses and thrums through the web of fractures in its design.

gear-weapon#0322.src: An attempt to rule with an iron fist, a power hellbent on control and force.  Unknown. How far does the indomitable spirit of humanity extend?
gear-weapon#0322.dst: 철권으로 다스리려는 시도, 통제와 무력에 혈안이 된 권력.  미지. 불굴의 인간 정신은 어디까지 뻗어 나갈 수 있는가?
gear-weapon#0322.flat: An attempt to rule with an iron fist, a power hellbent on control and force.  Unknown. How far does the indomitable spirit of humanity extend?

gear-weapon#0323.src: No one can hold you down anymore.
gear-weapon#0323.dst: 이제 누구도 너를 억누를 수 없다.
gear-weapon#0323.flat: No one can hold you down anymore.

gear-weapon#0324.src: The soul of a Devil is so hot with hatred that their  bodies melt like candle wax, coming off in molten globs of flesh until only black bones remain.
gear-weapon#0324.dst: 악마의 영혼은 증오로 너무 뜨거워서 그 몸이  촛농처럼 녹아내린다. 녹아내린 살덩이가 뚝뚝 떨어져 나가 검은 뼈만 남을 때까지.
gear-weapon#0324.flat: The soul of a Devil is so hot with hatred that their  bodies melt like candle wax, coming off in molten globs of flesh until only black bones remain.

gear-weapon#0325.src: You will probably irreversibly harm yourself with this, but when has that ever stopped you?
gear-weapon#0325.dst: 이걸로 아마 돌이킬 수 없게 스스로를 해치겠지만, 그게 언제 너를 멈춘 적이 있었나?
gear-weapon#0325.flat: You will probably irreversibly harm yourself with this, but when has that ever stopped you?

gear-weapon#0326.src: This spear comes alive in your hands. It whispers strategy and technique to you, a voice that cuts through the clash of metal and screams of the dying. It is always correct. It has only ever lost a single battle. Do not let it down.
gear-weapon#0326.dst: 이 창은 네 손에서 살아 움직인다. 금속이 부딪치는 소리와 죽어 가는 자들의 비명을 뚫고, 전략과 기술을 속삭여 준다. 그 목소리는 언제나 옳다. 단 한 번의 전투에서만 졌을 뿐이다. 실망시키지 마라.
gear-weapon#0326.flat: This spear comes alive in your hands. It whispers strategy and technique to you, a voice that cuts through the clash of metal and screams of the dying. It is always correct. It has only ever lost a single battle. Do not let it down.

gear-weapon#0328.src: The stones have a language. You can learn to direct their shiftings and discover their names; all you must do in return is forget your own.
gear-weapon#0328.dst: 돌에게는 언어가 있다. 너는 그들의 움직임을 지휘하고 그 이름을 알아내는 법을 배울 수 있다. 그 대가로 네가 할 일은 너 자신의 이름을 잊는 것뿐이다.
gear-weapon#0328.flat: The stones have a language. You can learn to direct their shiftings and discover their names; all you must do in return is forget your own.

gear-weapon#0329.src: Presto. Like a viper's strike, retreating before the prey even feels the fang. A blade defined by a speed that leaves no memory of its passing.
gear-weapon#0329.dst: 프레스토. 독사의 일격처럼, 먹잇감이 송곳니를 느끼기도 전에 물러난다. 지나간 기억조차 남기지 않는 속도로 정의되는 칼날.
gear-weapon#0329.flat: Presto. Like a viper's strike, retreating before the prey even feels the fang. A blade defined by a speed that leaves no memory of its passing.

gear-weapon#0330.src: Moderato. Like the disciplined steps of a march, never skipping its appointed mark. A wand defined by a constancy that brings order to chaos.
gear-weapon#0330.dst: 모데라토. 행진의 절도 있는 발걸음처럼, 정해진 박자를 결코 건너뛰지 않는다. 혼돈에 질서를 가져오는 한결같음으로 정의되는 완드.
gear-weapon#0330.flat: Moderato. Like the disciplined steps of a march, never skipping its appointed mark. A wand defined by a constancy that brings order to chaos.

gear-weapon#0331.src: Adagio. Like the heavy hammer of a blacksmith, striking slow to shape tempered steel. A crossbow defined by the deliberate power of its draw.
gear-weapon#0331.dst: 아다지오. 대장장이의 묵직한 망치처럼, 천천히 내리쳐 담금질한 강철을 빚는다. 신중하게 당기는 힘으로 정의되는 석궁.
gear-weapon#0331.flat: Adagio. Like the heavy hammer of a blacksmith, striking slow to shape tempered steel. A crossbow defined by the deliberate power of its draw.

gear-weapon#0332.src: Largo. Like the deep ocean tides governed by the moon, indifferent to the hurry of the world. A spear defined by a crushing momentum that nothing can halt.
gear-weapon#0332.dst: 라르고. 달이 다스리는 깊은 바다의 조수처럼, 세상의 조급함에는 무심하다. 그 무엇도 멈출 수 없는 압도적인 기세로 정의되는 창.
gear-weapon#0332.flat: Largo. Like the deep ocean tides governed by the moon, indifferent to the hurry of the world. A spear defined by a crushing momentum that nothing can halt.

gear-weapon#0333.src: No eyes see past the dark fog that enshrouds the future. But if you could perhaps light the way, what would you see? Invigorating hope? Or a warning to be heeded?
gear-weapon#0333.dst: 미래를 뒤덮은 어두운 안개 너머를 볼 수 있는 눈은 없다. 하지만 혹시 길을 밝힐 수 있다면, 무엇이 보일까? 힘이 솟는 희망? 아니면 새겨들어야 할 경고?
gear-weapon#0333.flat: No eyes see past the dark fog that enshrouds the future. But if you could perhaps light the way, what would you see? Invigorating hope? Or a warning to be heeded?

gear-weapon#0334.src: I'm not touching this with a... well. Yeah.
gear-weapon#0334.dst: 이건 내가 절대로... 음. 그래. 그거.
gear-weapon#0334.flat: I'm not touching this with a... well. Yeah.

gear-weapon#0335.src: The strength to keep going, to push on in the face of adversity. It's a rare kind of grit, the one that takes hold and won't let go until the task is done.
gear-weapon#0335.dst: 역경 앞에서도 계속 나아가고 밀어붙이는 힘. 한번 붙잡으면 일을 끝낼 때까지 놓지 않는, 보기 드문 근성이다.
gear-weapon#0335.flat: The strength to keep going, to push on in the face of adversity. It's a rare kind of grit, the one that takes hold and won't let go until the task is done.

gear-weapon#0336.src: Don't give them time for even a warning.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0336.dst: 경고할 시간조차 주지 마라. 무언가를 향해 끌려가고 있다.
gear-weapon#0336.flat: Don't give them time for even a warning.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0337.src: Forged from unbreakable obsidian eras ago, this heavy hammer has crushed many foes with a single swing.
gear-weapon#0337.dst: 수 시대 전 깨지지 않는 흑요석으로 벼려진 이 무거운 망치는 단 한 번의 휘두름으로 수많은 적을 짓뭉갰다.
gear-weapon#0337.flat: Forged from unbreakable obsidian eras ago, this heavy hammer has crushed many foes with a single swing.

gear-weapon#0338.src: Once having held unstoppable amounts of magic, being forced to fuse into one form locked away all but the smallest sliver of their power.
gear-weapon#0338.dst: 한때는 멈출 수 없을 만큼의 마력을 품고 있었으나, 하나의 형태로 강제로 융합되면서 극히 작은 조각을 제외한 모든 힘이 봉인되었다.
gear-weapon#0338.flat: Once having held unstoppable amounts of magic, being forced to fuse into one form locked away all but the smallest sliver of their power.

gear-weapon#0339.src: "How perfect can a form be? The creatures here are warped. Distorted. their flesh bubbles and oozes with the most toxic of acids. But it makes them powerful. Resilient. Perhaps it would be better to become one of them. Perhaps it would make your form . . . perfect."
gear-weapon#0339.dst: "형체는 얼마나 완벽해질 수 있을까? 이곳의 생물들은 뒤틀려 있다. 일그러져 있다. 그들의 살은 가장 독한 산으로 부글거리고 스며 나온다. 하지만 그것이 그들을 강하게 만든다. 끈질기게. 어쩌면 그들 중 하나가 되는 편이 나을지도 모른다. 어쩌면 그것이 너의 형체를... 완벽하게 만들어 줄지도."
gear-weapon#0339.flat: "How perfect can a form be? The creatures here are warped. Distorted. their flesh bubbles and oozes with the most toxic of acids. But it makes them powerful. Resilient. Perhaps it would be better to become one of them. Perhaps it would make your form . . . perfect."

gear-weapon#0340.src: This indestructible dagger was found floating in the magma of the {p}, with a lament from its exiled smith carved onto the hilt.
gear-weapon#0340.dst: 이 파괴되지 않는 단검은 {p}의 용암 위를 떠다니다 발견되었으며, 자루에는 추방당한 대장장이의 한탄이 새겨져 있다.
gear-weapon#0340.flat: This indestructible dagger was found floating in the magma of the {p}, with a lament from its exiled smith carved onto the hilt.
gear-weapon#0340._raw: This indestructible dagger was found floating in the magma of the Molten Heights, with a lament from its exiled smith carved onto the hilt.

gear-weapon#0341.src: "They tear the earth open day after day after day, ripping out her most precious and vital stones, and dumping them into the abyss of their hungry, bottomless coffers. They would sell out the world for a bit of cash; after all, these stones bleed green."
gear-weapon#0341.dst: "그들은 날이면 날마다 대지를 찢어발기고, 그녀의 가장 소중하고 중요한 돌들을 뜯어내 굶주린 밑 빠진 금고 속 심연에 쏟아붓는다. 돈 몇 푼에 세상을 팔아넘기겠지. 어쨌든 이 돌들은 초록 피를 흘리니까."
gear-weapon#0341.flat: "They tear the earth open day after day after day, ripping out her most precious and vital stones, and dumping them into the abyss of their hungry, bottomless coffers. They would sell out the world for a bit of cash; after all, these stones bleed green."

gear-weapon#0342.src: "In the days before they ripped out its heart, there was a pulse to these streets: the sanguine flow of life through the sturdy buildings and cobbled roads and hidden alleys. What remains is a bloodless husk, dusty walls populated solely by those hideous things which can only see and never know."
gear-weapon#0342.dst: "그들이 심장을 뜯어내기 전, 이 거리에는 고동이 있었다. 튼튼한 건물과 자갈길과 숨은 골목을 따라 흐르던 생명의 붉은 흐름. 남은 것은 피 한 방울 없는 껍데기, 볼 수만 있을 뿐 결코 알지 못하는 흉측한 것들만이 사는 먼지투성이 벽뿐이다."
gear-weapon#0342.flat: "In the days before they ripped out its heart, there was a pulse to these streets: the sanguine flow of life through the sturdy buildings and cobbled roads and hidden alleys. What remains is a bloodless husk, dusty walls populated solely by those hideous things which can only see and never know."

gear-weapon#0343.src: After eons spent in parochial search for something familiar, perhaps this blade should have been a hint to think outside the box.
gear-weapon#0343.dst: 익숙한 무언가를 편협하게 찾아 헤맨 영겁의 세월 끝에, 어쩌면 이 칼날이 틀에서 벗어나 생각하라는 힌트였어야 했는지도 모른다.
gear-weapon#0343.flat: After eons spent in parochial search for something familiar, perhaps this blade should have been a hint to think outside the box.

gear-weapon#0345.src: The ocean's bounty is full of many strange things. Sailor's tales of a peculiar fish with a snout like a sword and the unbelievable stories of its power thus inspired fanciful ideas in blacksmiths. The results speak for themselves.
gear-weapon#0345.dst: 바다의 선물에는 기이한 것이 가득하다. 칼 같은 주둥이를 가진 괴상한 물고기에 대한 선원들의 이야기와 그 힘에 관한 믿기 힘든 소문은 대장장이들에게 기발한 발상을 불어넣었다. 결과는 보는 그대로다.
gear-weapon#0345.flat: The ocean's bounty is full of many strange things. Sailor's tales of a peculiar fish with a snout like a sword and the unbelievable stories of its power thus inspired fanciful ideas in blacksmiths. The results speak for themselves.

gear-weapon#0346.src: "The feeling begins as a prickle on the neck. Is that tree staring? What does it see? How much does it know? This place is not right. It sees too much. It knows too much. The forest is staring at you. It burns the secrets out of you through its awful, unnatural retinas. There is nowhere to hide."
gear-weapon#0346.dst: "그 느낌은 목덜미가 따끔거리는 것으로 시작된다. 저 나무가 쳐다보고 있나? 무엇을 보고 있지? 얼마나 알고 있지? 이곳은 뭔가 잘못됐다. 너무 많이 본다. 너무 많이 안다. 숲이 너를 쳐다보고 있다. 그 끔찍하고 부자연스러운 망막으로 네 비밀을 태워 끄집어낸다. 숨을 곳은 없다."
gear-weapon#0346.flat: "The feeling begins as a prickle on the neck. Is that tree staring? What does it see? How much does it know? This place is not right. It sees too much. It knows too much. The forest is staring at you. It burns the secrets out of you through its awful, unnatural retinas. There is nowhere to hide."

gear-weapon#0347.src: "And no one's going to save us from the beasts about to strike. We've seen horrors stare us in the eyes, and we're fighting for our lives." -Poe, {p} Sewer Dweller
gear-weapon#0347.dst: "덮쳐 오는 짐승들에게서 우릴 구해 줄 사람은 아무도 없어. 우린 공포와 눈을 마주했고, 목숨을 걸고 싸우고 있지." -Poe, {p} 하수도 거주민
gear-weapon#0347.flat: "And no one's going to save us from the beasts about to strike. We've seen horrors stare us in the eyes, and we're fighting for our lives." -Poe, {p} Sewer Dweller
gear-weapon#0347._raw: "And no one's going to save us from the beasts about to strike. We've seen horrors stare us in the eyes, and we're fighting for our lives." -Poe, Nemract Sewer Dweller

gear-weapon#0348.src: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and consuming fury combine to create a deadly aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for utter cataclysm.
gear-weapon#0348.dst: 새겨진 Uth 룬의 힘과 모든 것을 삼키는 분노가 어우러져 치명적인 기운을 만들어 낸다. 이 무기는 완전한 대재앙을 바라는 사용자의 욕망이 영적으로 뻗어 나온 것에 불과하다.
gear-weapon#0348.flat: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and consuming fury combine to create a deadly aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for utter cataclysm.

gear-weapon#0349.src: The raw aspect of thunder, though claimed to be harnessed by a mage in a wand, has only been truly tamed by this mighty blade. Combined electric and life-draining magic intertwine and bring forth the truest, most frightening power of all Thunder.
gear-weapon#0349.dst: 번개의 원초적인 면모는 한 마법사가 완드에 담아냈다고 주장했지만, 진정으로 길들인 것은 이 강력한 칼날뿐이다. 전기와 생명을 빨아들이는 마법이 한데 얽혀, 모든 번개 중 가장 참되고 가장 무시무시한 힘을 끌어낸다.
gear-weapon#0349.flat: The raw aspect of thunder, though claimed to be harnessed by a mage in a wand, has only been truly tamed by this mighty blade. Combined electric and life-draining magic intertwine and bring forth the truest, most frightening power of all Thunder.

gear-weapon#0350.src: This bow has no string. Instead, a thin lightning-like thread is strung upon it. It is said to be limited only by the speed of the user.
gear-weapon#0350.dst: 이 활에는 시위가 없다. 대신 번개 같은 가느다란 실이 걸려 있다. 그 한계는 오직 사용자의 속도뿐이라고 한다.
gear-weapon#0350.flat: This bow has no string. Instead, a thin lightning-like thread is strung upon it. It is said to be limited only by the speed of the user.

gear-weapon#0351.src: This mysterious, half-liquid trident apparently holds the secret magics to control the ocean's ebb and flow. It is incapable of touching solid ground.
gear-weapon#0351.dst: 이 신비로운 반액체 삼지창은 바다의 밀물과 썰물을 다스리는 비밀스러운 마법을 품고 있다고 한다. 단단한 땅에는 닿을 수 없다.
gear-weapon#0351.flat: This mysterious, half-liquid trident apparently holds the secret magics to control the ocean's ebb and flow. It is incapable of touching solid ground.

gear-weapon#0352.src: The wear upon this broken old battle spear does not affect its ability in battle. The souls of a thousand fallen warriors resound within it.
gear-weapon#0352.dst: 이 부러진 낡은 전투용 창의 마모는 전투 능력에 아무런 영향을 주지 않는다. 쓰러진 천 명의 전사들의 영혼이 그 안에서 울려 퍼진다.
gear-weapon#0352.flat: The wear upon this broken old battle spear does not affect its ability in battle. The souls of a thousand fallen warriors resound within it.

gear-weapon#0353.src: This peculiar weapon was once wielded by the firey warrior Igbar, who used it to great effect in endurance competitions.
gear-weapon#0353.dst: 이 기묘한 무기는 한때 불같은 전사 Igbar가 휘둘렀으며, 그는 이것으로 지구력 대회에서 큰 활약을 했다.
gear-weapon#0353.flat: This peculiar weapon was once wielded by the firey warrior Igbar, who used it to great effect in endurance competitions.

gear-weapon#0354.src: The tides of the ocean, once bound, became useful magic power sources. They were once utilized for weapons, but to harness the unstable force of the raging sea was considered too dangerous.
gear-weapon#0354.dst: 한번 묶인 바다의 조수는 유용한 마력원이 되었다. 한때 무기에 쓰이기도 했지만, 성난 바다의 불안정한 힘을 다루는 것은 너무 위험하다고 여겨졌다.
gear-weapon#0354.flat: The tides of the ocean, once bound, became useful magic power sources. They were once utilized for weapons, but to harness the unstable force of the raging sea was considered too dangerous.

gear-weapon#0355.src: A hissing, cracking harmony swells, a maddening chorus to blare across the broken plains, yet still: unseen and alive, it swells with the beat of the earth, still breathing, still killing.
gear-weapon#0355.dst: 쉿쉿거리고 쩍쩍 갈라지는 화음이 부풀어 올라, 부서진 평원 너머로 울려 퍼지는 광기의 합창이 된다. 그럼에도 여전히 보이지 않고 살아 있으며, 대지의 박자에 맞춰 부풀고, 여전히 숨 쉬고, 여전히 죽인다.
gear-weapon#0355.flat: A hissing, cracking harmony swells, a maddening chorus to blare across the broken plains, yet still: unseen and alive, it swells with the beat of the earth, still breathing, still killing.

gear-weapon#0356.src: Can you feel the burning inside? Something has made itself at home. Time to tuck away the parts of you it has no need for, to shuffle your little brain around so you may Carry. Carry and Spread. Give it a new home-melting you down is how it says thank you. Be grateful, won't you?
gear-weapon#0356.dst: 안에서 타는 게 느껴지나? 무언가가 자리를 잡았다. 그것이 필요 없는 너의 부분들은 치워 두고, 네 작은 뇌를 이리저리 옮겨 네가 옮길 수 있게 할 시간이다. 옮기고 퍼뜨려라. 그것에게 새 집을 내주어라. 너를 녹여 버리는 것이 그것이 감사를 표하는 방식이다. 고마워해야지, 안 그래?
gear-weapon#0356.flat: Can you feel the burning inside? Something has made itself at home. Time to tuck away the parts of you it has no need for, to shuffle your little brain around so you may Carry. Carry and Spread. Give it a new home-melting you down is how it says thank you. Be grateful, won't you?

gear-weapon#0357.src: Down. Your enemies will fall slack. Deeper. Do you know this compulsion you bring? Deeper still. This implement, reaching from within and without. Even deeper. Souls and wills to command at the flex of a finger. Almost gone. It is my compulsion, too great to ignore. It is my implement, too strong to resist. My puppets, too deep to escape. Drop.
gear-weapon#0357.dst: 아래로. 너의 적들은 늘어질 것이다. 더 깊이. 네가 가져오는 이 강박을 아는가? 더욱 깊이. 이 도구는 안과 밖에서 손을 뻗는다. 훨씬 더 깊이. 손가락 하나 까딱하면 영혼과 의지를 부릴 수 있다. 거의 사라졌다. 이것은 나의 강박, 무시하기엔 너무 강하다. 이것은 나의 도구, 저항하기엔 너무 강하다. 나의 꼭두각시들, 빠져나가기엔 너무 깊다. 떨어져라.
gear-weapon#0357.flat: Down. Your enemies will fall slack. Deeper. Do you know this compulsion you bring? Deeper still. This implement, reaching from within and without. Even deeper. Souls and wills to command at the flex of a finger. Almost gone. It is my compulsion, too great to ignore. It is my implement, too strong to resist. My puppets, too deep to escape. Drop.

gear-weapon#0358.src: Desperation breeds creativity. What would it take to force your will upon the world? To bend and break and weave existence, to bypass the immutable? The result is different, wrong, anathema to your being... but it is freedom from the chains that bind you. It is enough.
gear-weapon#0358.dst: 절박함은 창의력을 낳는다. 세상에 너의 의지를 강요하려면 무엇이 필요할까? 존재를 구부리고 부수고 엮어, 불변을 우회하려면? 그 결과는 다르고, 잘못되었으며, 너의 존재에 대한 저주다... 하지만 그것은 너를 묶은 사슬로부터의 자유다. 그것으로 충분하다.
gear-weapon#0358.flat: Desperation breeds creativity. What would it take to force your will upon the world? To bend and break and weave existence, to bypass the immutable? The result is different, wrong, anathema to your being... but it is freedom from the chains that bind you. It is enough.

gear-weapon#0359.src: "It feels like all these "ancient" civilizations have better tech than we do nowadays."  -Knox, Corkus Immigrant and Sandstorm Vandals bandit
gear-weapon#0359.dst: "이 "고대" 문명들이 요즘 우리보다 기술이 더 좋은 것 같다니까."  -Knox, Corkus 이민자이자 모래폭풍 파괴단 강도
gear-weapon#0359.flat: "It feels like all these "ancient" civilizations have better tech than we do nowadays."  -Knox, Corkus Immigrant and Sandstorm Vandals bandit

gear-weapon#0360.src: Truth, bliss, emanation, guiding the path forward unto enlightenment.
gear-weapon#0360.dst: 진리, 지복, 발현. 깨달음으로 향하는 앞길을 인도한다.
gear-weapon#0360.flat: Truth, bliss, emanation, guiding the path forward unto enlightenment.

gear-weapon#0361.src: The hands of destiny tighten and slacken without remorse, pulling hearts together only to push them apart in a relentless dance.
gear-weapon#0361.dst: 운명의 손은 가차 없이 조였다 풀기를 반복하며, 마음들을 끌어모았다가 끝없는 춤 속에서 다시 떼어 놓는다.
gear-weapon#0361.flat: The hands of destiny tighten and slacken without remorse, pulling hearts together only to push them apart in a relentless dance.

gear-weapon#0362.src: It takes two voices to make harmony.
gear-weapon#0362.flat: It takes two voices to make harmony.

gear-weapon#0363.src: To drag into shadow. To stifle in darkness. Anything is possible with total, suffocating eclipse at your beck and call.
gear-weapon#0363.dst: 그림자 속으로 끌어들인다. 어둠 속에서 숨통을 조인다. 완전하고 숨 막히는 일식을 마음대로 부릴 수 있다면 무엇이든 가능하다.
gear-weapon#0363.flat: To drag into shadow. To stifle in darkness. Anything is possible with total, suffocating eclipse at your beck and call.

gear-weapon#0364.src: Sometimes, wavers in the light reveal visions of fantastical places.  A window or portal rippled into existence for just a moment, then winked out by a breeze.
gear-weapon#0364.dst: 때때로 빛의 일렁임이 환상적인 장소의 모습을 드러낸다.  창문이나 차원문이 잠시 물결치듯 나타났다가, 산들바람에 깜빡 사라진다.
gear-weapon#0364.flat: Sometimes, wavers in the light reveal visions of fantastical places.  A window or portal rippled into existence for just a moment, then winked out by a breeze.

gear-weapon#0365.src: It seems stronger at first glance, but upon closer inspection the blade is rather...soft?
gear-weapon#0365.dst: 얼핏 보면 더 강해 보이지만, 자세히 살펴보니 칼날이 좀... 물렁한가?
gear-weapon#0365.flat: It seems stronger at first glance, but upon closer inspection the blade is rather...soft?

gear-weapon#0366.src: "{~} curse-free or your money back!" The merchant explained that this policy is not legally binding after you read it.
gear-weapon#0366.dst: "{~} 저주 없음 보장, 아니면 환불!" 네가 읽고 나자 상인은 이 방침에 법적 구속력이 없다고 설명했다.
gear-weapon#0366.flat: "{~} curse-free or your money back!" The merchant explained that this policy is not legally binding after you read it.
gear-weapon#0366._raw: "100% curse-free or your money back!" The merchant explained that this policy is not legally binding after you read it.

gear-weapon#0367.src: The magic in this wand seems much weaker than normal...and there's a rather rude message written on the handle.
gear-weapon#0367.dst: 이 완드의 마력은 평소보다 훨씬 약한 것 같다... 게다가 손잡이에는 꽤 무례한 문구가 적혀 있다.
gear-weapon#0367.flat: The magic in this wand seems much weaker than normal...and there's a rather rude message written on the handle.

gear-weapon#0368.src: Did the merchant really think that adding severed bat wings to the weapon would make it more authentic?
gear-weapon#0368.dst: 상인은 정말로 무기에 잘라 낸 박쥐 날개를 붙이면 더 진짜 같아질 거라고 생각했을까?
gear-weapon#0368.flat: Did the merchant really think that adding severed bat wings to the weapon would make it more authentic?

gear-weapon#0369.src: The weapon nearly catches fire during the merchant's demonstration. He still refuses to discount it despite this.
gear-weapon#0369.dst: 상인이 시연하는 동안 무기에 불이 붙을 뻔했다. 그런데도 그는 여전히 값을 깎아 주지 않는다.
gear-weapon#0369.flat: The weapon nearly catches fire during the merchant's demonstration. He still refuses to discount it despite this.

gear-weapon#0370.src: The blade is covered in tape that's been scribbled on in order to make it look fiery. This doesn't seem like a wise purchase.
gear-weapon#0370.dst: 칼날에 테이프가 감겨 있고, 불타는 것처럼 보이게 하려고 낙서가 되어 있다. 현명한 구매는 아닌 것 같다.
gear-weapon#0370.flat: The blade is covered in tape that's been scribbled on in order to make it look fiery. This doesn't seem like a wise purchase.

gear-weapon#0371.src: Apparently, they thought to make a long bow better, they should make it longer. You can barely hold it.
gear-weapon#0371.dst: 아무래도 롱보우를 더 좋게 만들려면 더 길게 만들면 된다고 생각한 모양이다. 거의 들 수조차 없다.
gear-weapon#0371.flat: Apparently, they thought to make a long bow better, they should make it longer. You can barely hold it.

gear-weapon#0372.src: The inscribed lyrics have been scratched out and replaced with a barely-legible insult.
gear-weapon#0372.dst: 새겨진 가사는 긁혀 지워지고, 겨우 알아볼 수 있는 욕설로 바뀌어 있다.
gear-weapon#0372.flat: The inscribed lyrics have been scratched out and replaced with a barely-legible insult.

gear-weapon#0373.src: There are parts from at least six separately recognizable weapons mashed together to make this. There's no way it's effective.
gear-weapon#0373.dst: 적어도 여섯 개의 서로 다른 무기 부품을 알아볼 수 있을 만큼 억지로 짜 맞춘 물건이다. 쓸모 있을 리가 없다.
gear-weapon#0373.flat: There are parts from at least six separately recognizable weapons mashed together to make this. There's no way it's effective.

gear-weapon#0374.src: According to the merchant, the wand is extra flammable, so that it can burn up and disappear with all the mages quicker.
gear-weapon#0374.dst: 상인의 말에 따르면 이 완드는 유난히 불이 잘 붙어서, 메이지들과 함께 더 빨리 타서 사라질 수 있다고 한다.
gear-weapon#0374.flat: According to the merchant, the wand is extra flammable, so that it can burn up and disappear with all the mages quicker.

gear-weapon#0375.src: The craftsmanship on this bow is rather poor. The paint on the "crystals" is chipping...
gear-weapon#0375.dst: 이 활의 만듦새는 꽤 조잡하다. "수정"에 칠한 페인트가 벗겨지고 있다...
gear-weapon#0375.flat: The craftsmanship on this bow is rather poor. The paint on the "crystals" is chipping...

gear-weapon#0376.src: The blade actually looks to be of good quality, unlike the other products. The only problem is the questionable stain covering most of it.
gear-weapon#0376.dst: 다른 상품들과 달리 칼날 자체는 품질이 좋아 보인다. 유일한 문제는 대부분을 덮고 있는 수상한 얼룩이다.
gear-weapon#0376.flat: The blade actually looks to be of good quality, unlike the other products. The only problem is the questionable stain covering most of it.

gear-weapon#0377.src: It is significantly heavier than usual...you can't tell if that is good or not, in this case.
gear-weapon#0377.dst: 평소보다 훨씬 무겁다... 이 경우에는 그게 좋은 건지 아닌지 알 수가 없다.
gear-weapon#0377.flat: It is significantly heavier than usual...you can't tell if that is good or not, in this case.

gear-weapon#0378.src: The guard on the spear is smaller, but at least twice as thick. What purpose does that have?
gear-weapon#0378.dst: 창의 날밑은 더 작아졌지만, 두께는 적어도 두 배다. 대체 무슨 용도일까?
gear-weapon#0378.flat: The guard on the spear is smaller, but at least twice as thick. What purpose does that have?

gear-weapon#0379.src: The blade seems sharper than normal, but it also seems rather brittle. The smithing was obviously a hack-job...
gear-weapon#0379.dst: 칼날은 평소보다 날카로워 보이지만, 꽤 잘 부러질 것 같기도 하다. 대장일은 누가 봐도 대충 한 솜씨다...
gear-weapon#0379.flat: The blade seems sharper than normal, but it also seems rather brittle. The smithing was obviously a hack-job...

gear-weapon#0380.src: A strength fueled by rage, merciless, unending. A hatred, all-consuming, that erodes all other thought, all sense of being. An ally so fickle, so selfish, that leaves you aimless at the moment of pyrrhic triumph.
gear-weapon#0380.dst: 분노를 연료 삼은 힘, 무자비하고 끝이 없다. 모든 것을 삼키는 증오는 다른 모든 생각과 존재감을 갉아먹는다. 너무나 변덕스럽고 이기적인 이 동맹은, 상처뿐인 승리의 순간 너를 갈 곳 없이 남겨 둔다.
gear-weapon#0380.flat: A strength fueled by rage, merciless, unending. A hatred, all-consuming, that erodes all other thought, all sense of being. An ally so fickle, so selfish, that leaves you aimless at the moment of pyrrhic triumph.

gear-weapon#0381.src: The carving on this timeworn staff writes: Hisel Acetlrif
gear-weapon#0381.dst: 세월에 닳은 이 지팡이에 새겨진 글귀: Hisel Acetlrif
gear-weapon#0381.flat: The carving on this timeworn staff writes: Hisel Acetlrif

gear-weapon#0382.src: An attempt to discover opulence in stone; greed-fueled destruction and avaricious growth. Too far. Chaos was brought into the world, and greed begat death.
gear-weapon#0382.dst: 돌 속에서 부를 찾으려는 시도. 탐욕이 부른 파괴와 욕심 가득한 성장. 너무 멀리 갔다. 세상에 혼돈이 찾아왔고, 탐욕은 죽음을 낳았다.
gear-weapon#0382.flat: An attempt to discover opulence in stone; greed-fueled destruction and avaricious growth. Too far. Chaos was brought into the world, and greed begat death.

gear-weapon#0383.dst: 내장을, 바깥으로. 무언가를 향해 끌려가고 있다.

gear-weapon#0384.src: To look and say "I will go there," and to keep going until you find it...that's what's important.
gear-weapon#0384.dst: 바라보며 "저기로 가겠어"라고 말하고, 찾을 때까지 계속 나아가는 것... 그게 중요한 거야.
gear-weapon#0384.flat: To look and say "I will go there," and to keep going until you find it...that's what's important.

gear-weapon#0385.src: "I've been wishin' I was dead for a long time."
gear-weapon#0385.flat: "I've been wishin' I was dead for a long time."

gear-weapon#0386.src: The notorious and erratic magical inventor Gawrick once attempted to make teleportation scrolls obsolete, by creating items which would allow the user to phase into an ethereal state to move unhindered. He did not account for the physical ramifications of this process, however.
gear-weapon#0386.dst: 악명 높고 괴짜인 마법 발명가 Gawrick은 한때 사용자가 영체 상태로 전환해 거침없이 이동할 수 있는 물건을 만들어 순간이동 두루마리를 쓸모없게 만들려 했다. 그러나 그는 이 과정이 육체에 미칠 영향을 고려하지 않았다.
gear-weapon#0386.flat: The notorious and erratic magical inventor Gawrick once attempted to make teleportation scrolls obsolete, by creating items which would allow the user to phase into an ethereal state to move unhindered. He did not account for the physical ramifications of this process, however.

gear-weapon#0387.src: The mystery of the ocean's appearance has eluded scholars for centuries. It is believed that many years ago, warlocks used wands like this one in an attempt to submerge the world.
gear-weapon#0387.dst: 바다가 어떻게 생겨났는지는 수 세기 동안 학자들이 풀지 못한 수수께끼다. 오래전 흑마법사들이 이런 완드로 세상을 물에 잠기게 하려 했다고 전해진다.
gear-weapon#0387.flat: The mystery of the ocean's appearance has eluded scholars for centuries. It is believed that many years ago, warlocks used wands like this one in an attempt to submerge the world.

gear-weapon#0388.src: A relic of the past in {p} was weathered down to a dagger by the sheer power of the wind. When used in battle, mysterious intertwined wind and time magic give it no physical presence.
gear-weapon#0388.dst: {p}의 오래된 유물이 순수한 바람의 힘에 깎여 단검이 되었다. 전투에 쓰면 얽혀 있는 바람과 시간의 신비한 마법이 이것의 물리적 실체를 없애 버린다.
gear-weapon#0388.flat: A relic of the past in {p} was weathered down to a dagger by the sheer power of the wind. When used in battle, mysterious intertwined wind and time magic give it no physical presence.
gear-weapon#0388._raw: A relic of the past in Time Valley was weathered down to a dagger by the sheer power of the wind. When used in battle, mysterious intertwined wind and time magic give it no physical presence.

gear-weapon#0389.src: "And you thought walking into a cobweb was bad." -Ope, {p} Botanist
gear-weapon#0389.dst: "거미줄에 걸어 들어가는 게 최악인 줄 알았지?" -Ope, {p} 식물학자
gear-weapon#0389.flat: "And you thought walking into a cobweb was bad." -Ope, {p} Botanist
gear-weapon#0389._raw: "And you thought walking into a cobweb was bad." -Ope, Ragni Botanist

gear-weapon#0390.src: Warning - device in state of extreme disrepair. Operators may experience unstable output, resulting in severe heat production upsurges. Any damage to material will not be reimbursed, and users will not be compensated for any injuries, burns, or deaths caused by improper use.
gear-weapon#0390.dst: 경고 - 장치가 극도로 파손된 상태임. 작동자는 출력 불안정으로 인한 심각한 발열 급증을 겪을 수 있음. 자재 손상은 일절 보상하지 않으며, 부적절한 사용으로 인한 부상, 화상, 사망에 대해서도 보상하지 않음.
gear-weapon#0390.flat: Warning - device in state of extreme disrepair. Operators may experience unstable output, resulting in severe heat production upsurges. Any damage to material will not be reimbursed, and users will not be compensated for any injuries, burns, or deaths caused by improper use.

gear-weapon#0391.src: Wielded by the master of the Decrepit Sewers Dungeon, the arrows of this bow causes the target's body to slowly wither away.
gear-weapon#0391.dst: 낡은 하수도 던전의 주인이 휘두르던 활로, 화살에 맞은 대상의 몸은 서서히 시들어 간다.
gear-weapon#0391.flat: Wielded by the master of the Decrepit Sewers Dungeon, the arrows of this bow causes the target's body to slowly wither away.

gear-weapon#0392.src: Even reduced to just the bones, you can't help but feel bad for the poor thing this paw came from.
gear-weapon#0392.dst: 뼈만 남았는데도, 이 발이 원래 붙어 있던 불쌍한 녀석이 안쓰러워지는 건 어쩔 수 없다.
gear-weapon#0392.flat: Even reduced to just the bones, you can't help but feel bad for the poor thing this paw came from.

gear-weapon#0393.src: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and sheer rage intertwine to create a fearsome sight, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for total destruction.
gear-weapon#0393.dst: 새겨진 Uth 룬의 힘과 순수한 분노가 얽혀 무시무시한 광경을 만들어 낸다. 이 무기는 완전한 파괴를 바라는 사용자의 욕망이 영적으로 뻗어 나온 것에 불과하다.
gear-weapon#0393.flat: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and sheer rage intertwine to create a fearsome sight, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for total destruction.

gear-weapon#0394.src: The unstable power within this bow is capable of great destruction, but seems to zero out at the most crucial moments in battle. Only the most skillful archers can wield this weapon with confidence.
gear-weapon#0394.dst: 이 활 속의 불안정한 힘은 엄청난 파괴를 일으킬 수 있지만, 전투에서 가장 중요한 순간마다 0이 되어 버리는 듯하다. 가장 숙련된 궁수만이 자신 있게 이 무기를 다룰 수 있다.
gear-weapon#0394.flat: The unstable power within this bow is capable of great destruction, but seems to zero out at the most crucial moments in battle. Only the most skillful archers can wield this weapon with confidence.
